title: Alcohol consumption summary (real CC-BY prose from Our World in Data)

source.attribution: Our World in Data (Ritchie, Roser), CC-BY-4.0
source.notes: Composed from real Our World in Data figures (CC-BY): ~1% of people have an alcohol use disorder; in South Africa and Papua New Guinea more than half of traffic deaths are alcohol-attributable; France in the 1920s averaged 22.1 litres of pure alcohol per adult per year. Complements/derivations added and verified consistent (1% = one in a hundred; 22.1 L/yr ~ 60 mL/day) before injecting 3 defects.

construction.proposer: opus-4.8 (proposed); audited & confirmed 2026-07-05 via oracle audit (validator + anchor-resolution + real/findable/unique pass, docs/oracle-audit-2026-07-05.md) with a targeted human audit of ambiguous/interacting defects and all gray zones (docs/human-audit-checklist)

known_gray_zone.note: Figures are estimates; the mL/day value is a derived conversion. A reviewer may want sources. Not a seeded defect.
